headline: Last session: Sensex slipped into red after CAS while Nifty gained 75 points; markets fell for the sixth week.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Sensex slipped into red after CAS while Nifty 50 managed a 75-point gain.
Oil prices and US Fed policy signals acted as key triggers for the weekly decline.
Markets faced their sixth consecutive weekly fall amid global economic uncertainty.
Investor sentiment was dampened by concerns over tighter US H-1B visa regulations.
whatHappening: NTPC terminated a ₹413 crore BESS contract due to contractor performance issues.
Paytm shares remained in focus as investors analyzed recent market opening trends.
Maharashtra's MSEDCL adopted AI and ML modules to detect and prevent power theft.
Smallcap indices showed resilience even as major benchmarks struggled to maintain gains.
summary: Indian markets ended the last session mixed as Sensex slipped into red while Nifty gained 75 points. The indices recorded a sixth straight weekly loss driven by US Fed signals and fluctuating oil prices. NTPC terminated a significant contract, and IT stocks faced pressure from potential US H-1B visa policy changes.
